title: Weekly ODNI briefings for national-security reporters (Mockingbird)

tellings.quote: They they go to places like OD and I on a weekly basis and get their briefing for what they're going to talk about next week.

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, says that national-security reporters go every week to places like the ODNI, the office that oversees America's spy agencies, to get briefed on what they will talk about the following week. He links this to "Mockingbird", a name taken from talk of a past CIA effort to steer the press. If true, it would mean the news on secret matters is shaped by the government in advance.
